title: Sums of Three Cubes Representation Conjecture
exact_target: Is the obstruction modulo nine the only reason an integer cannot be written as three integer cubes? A stronger version asks for infinitely many representations.

sources.citation: T. Browning, J. Glas, V. Y. Wang, "Sums of three cubes over a function field," arXiv:2402.07146 (2024); published as "Optimal sums of three cubes in F\_q[t]," Math. Z. (2025).
